subject: Include a time varying covariate in my model

messages.author: 32ee0060f636e4f2
messages.subject: Include a time varying covariate in my model
parts:
I have a dataset of admissions over time. I want to include a time varying covariate in the model how can I go about that. i.e I have age of a person, the age is different at each admission time point.How can I specify that.
My model is specified as below

formulaUH <- admission_count ~ f(loc_ID, model = "iid") +  f(loc_ID2,model="besag",graph=klf.adj) +  f(time, model = "ar1")

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Include a time varying covariate in my model
parts:
you can add a weight, like this

f(time, weight, model="rw2")


this would give

``weight(time) * f(time)''

so the 'regression coefficient' is the model defined in f().

H
